mentions.name: Dearest
mentions.description: A private weekly email digest service for staying in touch with family and friends. Each week, members email in a few photos and a sentence or two of updates, and Dearest compiles them into a private Sunday digest sent to the whole group; the catch is that only people who contributed that week receive the digest, encouraging participation. It aims to help small groups stay close without social media, another app, or endless notifications.
mentions.problem: Staying close with family and friends without another app, social media, or endless notifications.
mentions.audience: Families, old friends, grandparents, siblings, or any small group that wants to stay close without another app or endless notifications.
mentions.source_excerpt: Each week, everyone emails in a few photos and a sentence or two, and Dearest sends the group a private Sunday digest with everyone’s updates. The catch is, you only receive the digest if you contribute that week.
